Just as the stripes in patterns encountered in nature or in Islamic art provide a harmonious unity across diverse elements, the name Sihah symbolizes the consistent and uniform adherence to the tenets of the Islamic faith. It is a reminder for the bearer of this name to stay steadfast in her faith and to strive for unity in her personal relationship with Allah SWT and with the broader Muslim community. The name Sihah, therefore, embodies the essence of faithfulness, perseverance, and unity, making it a truly meaningful and spiritual name for a girl in the Islamic tradition.
